seller.onboarding_service_info: 🏦 Seller Bot — NewLookup What is this? NewLookup is a marketplace for digital goods. As a seller you upload products, buyers purchase them — you get paid automatically. Categories available: • 🏦 Bank accounts (logs, selfreg, brute) • 💳 Credit cards (with fullz / without) • 🪪 Enroll items • 📋 Checks, NFC, OTP, Documents, Fullz How it works: 1. Pay the security deposit for the categories you want 2. Upload products via bot or Mini App 3. Products go through moderation 4. Approved products go on sale 5. You receive payment for every purchase Payouts: Withdraw your balance at any time. Auto-payout is available. ⚠️ Important: Fraud, leaks, and rule violations result in permanent ban and deposit forfeiture.
seller.deposit_info: 🔐 Security Deposit To start selling, you must pay a refundable security deposit. The deposit is held as collateral — you get it back when you leave the platform in good standing. Packages: • 🏦 Bank package — $100 → access to Banks, Enrol, Brute • 💳 CC package — $50 → access to Credit Cards • 🏦+ Bank Plus — $150 → Bank + Logs, NFC, OTP, Checks • 💳+ CC Plus — $100 → CC + Selfreg CC • 🎯 Full package — $250 → all categories ⚠️ Ban conditions: • Leaking buyer credentials — instant ban, deposit forfeited • Fraud or fake products — ban, deposit forfeited • Repeated quality violations — deposit partially withheld Choose a package to proceed:
